coordinateConclusion.status: supported coordinate-conversion correction, not yet implemented/validated
facts: Apple Metal texture sample describes top-left origin.
Apple Core Image context documentation states bottom-left coordinate origin.
Current code feeds MTLTexture directly to CIImage then eager CGImage and UIImage.up without a conversion.

coordinateConclusion.narrowRecommendation: A fixed vertical orientation conversion at CIImage before eager CGImage, keeping normalized UIImage.up/PNG, is justified by coordinate contracts and observed failure; no camera/light/geometry edits. Root independently identified CIImage.oriented(.downMirrored).
